Alerts when 8K PRO is closed

Leave both blank for 8K PRO’s shared Worker. A custom Worker URL takes priority over a direct API key. Account sessions remain profile-specific.
Your TMDB API key and self-hosted server address will be deleted from this device, and 8K PRO will go back to the built-in shared service with its daily share.

The built-in service is shared by everyone using 8K PRO. If any minute, hourly or daily allowance is used up, TMDB details pause until that window resets; playlist information keeps working. Your own key or Worker removes this allowance.

What 8K PRO opens when it starts

On any device with a browser on the same Wi-Fi — a phone, a computer or another TV — scan the QR (or open the URL), enter this PIN, choose your 8K PRO backup file and send it. You then pick what to restore here.
8K PRO player

Many providers never say how many channels you may watch at the same time, so 8K PRO finds out by opening a few and seeing which ones survive. Anything playing now will stop, and this can take up to two minutes.
8K PRO could not work out how many channels this provider allows.
Resolve all 8K PRO domain lookups through a custom DNS server.

If a live channel has shown no picture by this time, 8K PRO stops trying and tells you, instead of leaving a black screen while it works through every player it has. Never keeps trying, which can take well over a minute on a channel your provider has removed. Waits your provider asks for are not counted.
Surround — send Dolby/DTS to a real 5.1/7.1 receiver. If it goes silent or stutters, 8K PRO still falls back to stereo and tells you.

8K PRO is a media player only. It includes no channels, playlists, or content. You are responsible for adding your own legally accessible Xtream, M3U, or Stalker sources.

Your TV has prepared an 8K PRO backup file. Tap the button to save it to this device (owntv-backup.own). Keep it somewhere safe \u2014 you can restore from it later.
